units.rawText: I've found your weakness.

units.rawText: Ugh...!
units.displayText: Ugh...!

units.displayText: Big Si, Tetris Style!

units.rawText: The huge snake hisses and operand blocks rapidly stack up, blocking Nameless' bullets.
units.displayText: The huge snake hisses and operand blocks rapidly stack up, blocking Nameless' bullets.

spans.text: The huge snake hisses and operand blocks rapidly stack up, blocking Nameless' bullets.

units.rawText: Don't push yourself, Zangyin.
units.displayText: Don't push yourself, Zangyin.

spans.text: Don't push yourself, Zangyin.

units.rawText: Your weaknesses are too obvious. This snake is powerful, but the recovery time between each attack is very long.
units.displayText: Your weaknesses are too obvious. This snake is powerful, but the recovery time between each attack is very long.

spans.text: Your weaknesses are too obvious. This snake is powerful, but the recovery time between each attack is very long.

units.rawText: He attacks the large snake as he says so, destroying the illusionary cubes one after another.
units.displayText: He attacks the large snake as he says so, destroying the illusionary cubes one after another.

spans.text: He attacks the large snake as he says so, destroying the illusionary cubes one after another.

units.rawText: Same goes for your defense. Even if you fine-tune your defense to resist bullets, it does no good against other things.
units.displayText: Same goes for your defense. Even if you fine-tune your defense to resist bullets, it does no good against other things.

spans.text: Same goes for your defense. Even if you fine-tune your defense to resist bullets, it does no good against other things.

units.rawText: The heavy shield smashes the savage serpent's fangs and connects with Zangyin's body, sending her flying.
units.displayText: The heavy shield smashes the savage serpent's fangs and connects with Zangyin's body, sending her flying.

spans.text: The heavy shield smashes the savage serpent's fangs and connects with Zangyin's body, sending her flying.

units.rawText: Guargh...!
units.displayText: Guargh...!

spans.text: Guargh...!

units.rawText: The huge snake swiftly coils up at her landing point and catches Zangyin in its coils.
units.displayText: The huge snake swiftly coils up at her landing point and catches Zangyin in its coils.

spans.text: The huge snake swiftly coils up at her landing point and catches Zangyin in its coils.

units.rawText: Nameless doesn't press the attack, merely watching her stand back up with the snake's help.
units.displayText: Nameless doesn't press the attack, merely watching her stand back up with the snake's help.

spans.text: Nameless doesn't press the attack, merely watching her stand back up with the snake's help.

units.rawText: For the last time, I advise that you leave Cyclopes immediately.
units.displayText: For the last time, I advise that you leave Cyclopes immediately.

spans.text: For the last time, I advise that you leave Cyclopes immediately.

units.rawText: Zangyin doesn't reply, and the snake coils around the cube before taking up a battle-ready stance.
units.displayText: Zangyin doesn't reply, and the snake coils around the cube before taking up a battle-ready stance.

spans.text: Zangyin doesn't reply, and the snake coils around the cube before taking up a battle-ready stance.

units.rawText: Why are you so obsessed with this? You barely know anything about our history. You're just a scholar flipping through it.
units.displayText: Why are you so obsessed with this? You barely know anything about our history. You're just a scholar flipping through it.

spans.text: Why are you so obsessed with this? You barely know anything about our history. You're just a scholar flipping through it.

units.rawText: All you did was destroy a simple structure and listen to some stories.
units.displayText: All you did was destroy a simple structure and listen to some stories.

spans.text: All you did was destroy a simple structure and listen to some stories.

units.rawText: Do you understand the meaning behind these things? Do you understand what every single word and symbol of every single little character detail means to us?
units.displayText: Do you understand the meaning behind these things? Do you understand what every single word and symbol of every single little character detail means to us?

spans.text: Do you understand the meaning behind these things? Do you understand what every single word and symbol of every single little character detail means to us?

units.rawText: I don't understand, but I'm in the process of doing so.
units.displayText: I don't understand, but I'm in the process of doing so.

spans.text: I don't understand, but I'm in the process of doing so.

units.rawText: Are you still trying that crude wordplay at a time like this?
units.displayText: Are you still trying that crude wordplay at a time like this?

spans.text: Are you still trying that crude wordplay at a time like this?

units.rawText: You're trying to understand? Are you kidding me? Cyclopes isn't that simple.
units.displayText: You're trying to understand? Are you kidding me? Cyclopes isn't that simple.

spans.text: You're trying to understand? Are you kidding me? Cyclopes isn't that simple.

units.rawText: I'm not talking about Cyclopes, Nameless.
units.displayText: I'm not talking about Cyclopes, Nameless.

spans.text: I'm not talking about Cyclopes, Nameless.

units.rawText: What I'm saying is that your actions are helping me start to understand Professor Teng.
units.displayText: What I'm saying is that your actions are helping me start to understand Professor Teng.

spans.text: What I'm saying is that your actions are helping me start to understand Professor Teng.

units.rawText: To Professor Teng, the traces of a culture about to be consumed by the fires of war are things that he would protect even at the cost of grinding himself to dust.
units.displayText: To Professor Teng, the traces of a culture about to be consumed by the fires of war are things that he would protect even at the cost of grinding himself to dust.

spans.text: To Professor Teng, the traces of a culture about to be consumed by the fires of war are things that he would protect even at the cost of grinding himself to dust.

units.rawText: What... are you talking about?
units.displayText: What... are you talking about?

spans.text: What... are you talking about?

units.rawText: Everything you're doing is to fulfil the prayer in your heart, to protect the thing you cherish.
units.displayText: Everything you're doing is to fulfil the prayer in your heart, to protect the thing you cherish.

spans.text: Everything you're doing is to fulfil the prayer in your heart, to protect the thing you cherish.

units.rawText: Since you know this, then why are you trying to stop me?
units.displayText: Since you know this, then why are you trying to stop me?

spans.text: Since you know this, then why are you trying to stop me?

units.rawText: Oh yes, I understand it, and I accept it... And I know how arrogant my previous thinking was.
units.displayText: Oh yes, I understand it, and I accept it... And I know how arrogant my previous thinking was.

spans.text: Oh yes, I understand it, and I accept it... And I know how arrogant my previous thinking was.

units.rawText: I couldn't even fix a house without your help, and here I was, thinking I could help restore an entire sector.
units.displayText: I couldn't even fix a house without your help, and here I was, thinking I could help restore an entire sector.

spans.text: I couldn't even fix a house without your help, and here I was, thinking I could help restore an entire sector.

units.rawText: If you understand, then step aside.
units.displayText: If you understand, then step aside.

spans.text: If you understand, then step aside.

units.rawText: You think you can get Tasha back through battle, but I've seen the results of far too many battles.
units.displayText: You think you can get Tasha back through battle, but I've seen the results of far too many battles.

spans.text: You think you can get Tasha back through battle, but I've seen the results of far too many battles.

units.rawText: The fighting will destroy even more of the sector's traces, and the first trace to be destroyed will be the you that Tasha left behind.
units.displayText: The fighting will destroy even more of the sector's traces, and the first trace to be destroyed will be the you that Tasha left behind.

spans.text: The fighting will destroy even more of the sector's traces, and the first trace to be destroyed will be the you that Tasha left behind.

units.rawText: Zangyin wipes away the blood on her face and looks at Nameless. Nameless can sense the determination burning in her eyes.
units.displayText: Zangyin wipes away the blood on her face and looks at Nameless. Nameless can sense the determination burning in her eyes.

spans.text: Zangyin wipes away the blood on her face and looks at Nameless. Nameless can sense the determination burning in her eyes.

units.rawText: In the past, I didn't know why the old man fought so hard because I didn't think it was worthwhile.
units.displayText: In the past, I didn't know why the old man fought so hard because I didn't think it was worthwhile.

spans.text: In the past, I didn't know why the old man fought so hard because I didn't think it was worthwhile.

units.rawText: But now, I have a goal that's worth it. I'm going to protect the history here and fix it, not reset it.
units.displayText: But now, I have a goal that's worth it. I'm going to protect the history here and fix it, not reset it.

spans.text: But now, I have a goal that's worth it. I'm going to protect the history here and fix it, not reset it.

units.rawText: Even if it means fighting a battle I have little hope of winning...
units.displayText: Even if it means fighting a battle I have little hope of winning...

spans.text: Even if it means fighting a battle I have little hope of winning...

units.rawText: You'll be the first to be reset, and the Cloud Sector, where your blueprints are, is nowhere to be found.
units.displayText: You'll be the first to be reset, and the Cloud Sector, where your blueprints are, is nowhere to be found.

spans.text: You'll be the first to be reset, and the Cloud Sector, where your blueprints are, is nowhere to be found.

units.rawText: Zangyin sucks in a breath, as though she's recalling something, and then she laughs quietly.
units.displayText: Zangyin sucks in a breath, as though she's recalling something, and then she laughs quietly.

spans.text: Zangyin sucks in a breath, as though she's recalling something, and then she laughs quietly.

units.rawText: Just as the celestial bodies never cease in their movement, so should a gentleman never cease to improve himself.
units.displayText: Just as the celestial bodies never cease in their movement, so should a gentleman never cease to improve himself.

spans.text: Just as the celestial bodies never cease in their movement, so should a gentleman never cease to improve himself.

units.rawText: What?
units.displayText: What?

spans.text: What?

units.rawText: If you don't get it, then just pretend I said that you make your fate with your own hands.
units.displayText: If you don't get it, then just pretend I said that you make your fate with your own hands.

spans.text: If you don't get it, then just pretend I said that you make your fate with your own hands.

units.rawText: I will protect you, and through that action I will protect Cyclopes, which has been through the fires of war and that which is about to take a step forward.
units.displayText: I will protect you, and through that action I will protect Cyclopes, which has been through the fires of war and that which is about to take a step forward.

spans.text: I will protect you, and through that action I will protect Cyclopes, which has been through the fires of war and that which is about to take a step forward.

units.rawText: I'll do it, no matter how unlikely it is that I can succeed.
units.displayText: I'll do it, no matter how unlikely it is that I can succeed.

spans.text: I'll do it, no matter how unlikely it is that I can succeed.

units.rawText: ...You are utterly impervious to reason.
units.displayText: ...You are utterly impervious to reason.

spans.text: ...You are utterly impervious to reason.

units.rawText: Nameless takes a deep breath, and ripples of operand fluctuations course over his body.
units.displayText: Nameless takes a deep breath, and ripples of operand fluctuations course over his body.

spans.text: Nameless takes a deep breath, and ripples of operand fluctuations course over his body.

units.rawText: I should never have allowed you to sway my neural cloud. The Cyclopes Sector doesn't need to be fixed. Once it is reset, everything will return to how it was.
units.displayText: I should never have allowed you to sway my neural cloud. The Cyclopes Sector doesn't need to be fixed. Once it is reset, everything will return to how it was.

spans.text: I should never have allowed you to sway my neural cloud. The Cyclopes Sector doesn't need to be fixed. Once it is reset, everything will return to how it was.
